module: JSON/SJSON parser that builds a lossless syntax tree (AST): every space, tab, line break, comment (// and /* */), delimiter, string and number (with its precision) becomes a node. A .jbeam file can thus be re-read, have values modified and be written back identically (stringify). Used by the built-in jbeam text editor; besides the AST it produces the native Lua data and the already-processed jbeam table schema.
usage:
local jsonAst = require('json-ast')
local ctx = jsonAst.parse(readFile('vehicles/pickup/pickup.jbeam'))
if ctx then
  local data = ctx.transient.luaData  -- native data (processed jbeam schema)
  local text = jsonAst.stringify(ctx.ast) -- must give back the original text
end
notes: A node is a table {type, value, precision?}. Types produced: object_begin, object_end, list_begin, list_end, array_delimiter, key_delimiter, newline, newline_windows, bool, string, string_single, number ({'number', value, decimalCount}, with prefixPlus and addPostfixDot), comment, comment_multiline, space ({'space', n}), tab, literal (fallback when nothing is recognized: logged as an error).

parse returns a context ctx (or nil if there are several roots) with: ctx.ast.nodes (list of nodes); ctx.transient.hierarchy (container node index -> children indices); ctx.transient.root (root node index); ctx.transient.luaDataRaw (raw native data); ctx.transient.luaData (deep copy after jbeamTableSchema.process on each section and creation of pos = vec3(posX,posY,posZ)); ctx.transient.linesIndexes (index of the first node of each line); ctx.transient.nodeIdxToLineNum. ctx.str and ctx.pos are removed.
With addAstId true, each native table (list or object) receives an __astNodeIdx field that points to its AST node; each processed section also receives __schemaProcessed = true.

Single-quoted strings are rewritten with double quotes by stringify, and escaping is not handled: a string containing an escaped quote is not written back identically (the parser does not handle \ sequences).
The jbeam test also compares with the fast parser (json.decode) and writes *_dump_ast.txt / *.ast.json files in case of a difference: development utility.
The extracted page did not list findDifferences: it is a local function (not exported).

parse.desc: Parses a JSON/SJSON/jbeam text and returns the context (AST + Lua data). Returns nil if the text contains several root nodes. Number or unknown-character errors are logged (log E) without stopping.

returns.desc: context {ast = {nodes}, transient = {luaData, luaDataRaw, hierarchy, root, linesIndexes, nodeIdxToLineNum}}

stringify.desc: Rebuilds the text from an AST (concatenates stringifyNodes(ast.nodes)).

stringifyNode.desc: Text of a single node (e.g. '{' for object_begin, '//comment', number formatted with its original precision). Returns nil for an unknown type.

stringifyNodes.desc: Concatenates the text of all the nodes in a list (Lua error if a node has an unknown type, because stringifyNode returns nil).

testFile.desc: Test tool: reads a file, parses it, compares with json.decode, rebuilds the text and checks that it is identical to the original. Writes diagnostic files in case of a difference. Returns true if the parse -> stringify cycle is lossless.

testFiles.desc: Test tool: runs testFile on all the *.jbeam files found from the root ('/') and logs the errors (and the OKs if reportOK).
